answer: Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in island, and harbor names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 8 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 4 hours of verification and 22 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
